name: android_double_tap
description: Executes a rapid double-tap gesture within the native Android double-tap window (default 120ms) to seek video (+10s/-10s), zoom, or trigger secondary actions.

xRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

yRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

xPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over raw x/y.
